title: MeloLingua CEFR-Graded Multilingual Stories
subtitle: 118 A1-B2 stories in six languages with aligned English learning support
description: A citable educational corpus of 118 public graded stories in German, Spanish, French, Italian, Korean, and Russian. Includes sentence-aligned English translations, contextual vocabulary, comprehension questions, sentence-building exercises, teaching metadata, provenance, and canonical links to https://melolingua.com.

resources.description: One row per public graded story with nested learning fields serialized as JSON.
One row per aligned target-language and English sentence pair.
One row per vocabulary item with source-story context.
One row per multiple-choice comprehension question.
Canonical nested dataset with all educational and provenance fields.
